entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET SDK 11.0.100 Static Web Assets net472 tasks ship an incompatible Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces version #57068
  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet-watch test host crashes during ServerAndResources #57065
  • CA1517 false positive when indexing and writing directly to a member `data[0].X = 1` #57061
  • [AI discovered CI] Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.IntegrationTests timeout in CanReadManifestFromRegistry #57058
  • dotnetup: Reconsider support for stable-branded preview builds #57052

Closed

  • `dotnet reference --help` shows incorrect description line #51674
  • [AI discovered CI] PersistentStorageTelemetryE2ETests telemetry drain assertion recurring in Windows CI #56957
  • .NET Project dependency "Microsoft.Windows.SDK.NET.dll" ist not handled correctly #36465
    Backlog
  • dotnet nuget never exits when run as PID 1 on first use (no first-use sentinel) #57062
  • `dotnet list package --format json` generates invalid JSON output on error in PT-BR translation #57063
  • .NET Core App 3.x can't find WindowsRuntime when TargetFrameworks has .NET 10 or later #57060
  • Revalidate references to dotnet/sdk#17 #56594

PullRequests

Created

  • Publish dotnetup musl release candidate artifacts #57073
  • Use Azure Linux 4 for Helix queues #57072
    Servicing-consider
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.4xx #57071
    Servicing-consider
  • Enable optimized Native AOT publish by default #57070
  • Fix dotnet-watch temporary solution sharing on Windows #57066
  • Bound external registry manifest test duration #57059
  • Reduce CA1851 and shared dataflow analysis overhead #57054
  • Allow extending metadata preserved by GetCopyToPublishDirectoryItems #57053
  • Use proper Registry Lookup for 64 Bit Machines in `dotnetup` #57051

Merged

  • RID graphs: add the openharmony RID and the crossgen2 mapping #56732
  • Fix dotnet reference help description #56969
  • Fix flaky cross-entry-point telemetry drain assertion #57018
  • [Security] Create dotnet-watch solution files privately #57030
  • Fix native MTP target framework and runtime display #57035
  • Clarify legacy platform library lookup #56987
    12.0-preview1
  • Remove unused native CLI task resources and trim off-platform detection providers #56555
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Add CDN publishing pipeline for dnup #56844
  • dotnetup: enumerate system installs without loading hostfxr #56935
  • Select issue triage assignees deterministically #57074
  • dotnetup: stop Windows installer downgrades from turning into failed repairs #57016
  • Optimize top-level command help parsing #56267
  • Include core SDK task deps.json in NuGet packages #57041
  • [release/10.400] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #57019
    Servicing-consider, Servicing-approved
  • Indicate `dotnet store` deprecation in CLI help #56956
  • Avoid mutating shared command metadata when rendering help #56974
  • Show --property in dotnet build help #56973
  • Fix cancellation rollback and Run API stdin handling #56979
  • Escape literal output paths before forwarding to MSBuild #56972
  • Make ProjectAssetsFile available in cross-targeting builds #57006
  • [wasm] Require the browser workload when CoreCLR sets WasmRunWasmOpt #56967
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57025
  • Generate SDK layout apphosts incrementally #56764
  • CA1826: use index-from-end expression for Last() code fix in C# 8+ #53475
  • Cache platform manifest conflict items per build #56164
    Servicing-consider, stale
  • Add unsafe v2 support to GenAPI #56907
  • Avoid shadowing existing shell profiles in Linux global-tool PATH guidance #56900
  • Guard Visual Studio resolver public APIs #55930
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Templates, Area-SdkResolvers, Area-Workloads, Area-ApiCompat
  • Emit CLI process identity as OpenTelemetry resource attributes #56579
    Area-Telemetry
  • Upgrade agentic workflow action pins #56588
    agentic-workflows
